readings: Considering only films whose replacement_cost is strictly greater than 20.99 (replacement_cost > 20.99, so films at exactly 20.99 are excluded), compute for each rating the average length and the average of rental_rate/replacement_cost, ignoring NULL values. Then return one row: the unrounded average of the per-rating average lengths, followed by the unrounded average of the per-rating average ratios.

Considering only films whose replacement_cost is at least 20.99 (replacement_cost >= 20.99, so films at exactly 20.99 are included), compute for each rating the average length and the average of rental_rate/replacement_cost, ignoring NULL values. Then return one row: the unrounded average of the per-rating average lengths, followed by the unrounded average of the per-rating average ratios.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_len), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
